query: Unedited upstream issue title; original project BM25 on all non-smoke actions; stable menu order for score ties. Positive top score and (first-second)/first <= 0.05, unrounded.
substantive: Both first and second documents must each have a positive BM25 contribution from at least one title word and one action word in the same frozen domain vocabulary below with the identical BM25 token. The same component word is allowed for both; record the actual words for each independently. No camel-case splitting, synonym expansion or rewriting. Generic words (including using/us) never certify a match.

vocabulary.carousel: carousel carousels slide slides keyboard keyboards input inputs focus focused viewport viewports layout layouts resize resized navigate navigation direction directions directional reverse grouped group groups
vocabulary.date: calendar calendars date dates day days month months year years grid grids keyboard keyboards focus focused input inputs range ranges time times hour hours minute minutes endpoint endpoints disabled

intake: First retain the previous 54 references for screening controls only. Expand the three archived release sources to at most 300 distinct references per library in the previous source traversal and round-robin order. Rank every available title. If this does not produce two qualified tickets, permit one supplementary fixed cohort: for the same three repositories, newest 300 closed public issues (excluding PRs) created between 2022-01-01 and 2025-06-30 inclusive, per repository, sorted by creation descending, filtered after acquisition. Remove repeated identifiers, preserve overlaps. Supplementary cases require independent public release/fix evidence before counting. Exclude previously listed issues, open issues, PRs, feature requests and non-interface reports. Intake extracts titles only and does not investigate security reports.
priority: Previous screened IDs are never new samples. Traverse new references round-robin by archive position, then the supplementary batch round-robin. Run eligible cases in that order until two qualify. Log exact reasons for unsupported environments, release ambiguity, controls failing on both versions, or failures that do not reproduce. Never rank candidates using acceptance reads. A common failing control is a rejected panel, not a regression. Preserve every attempted panel and at most one documented repair of an unrelated control per panel.
acceptance: Before candidate execution seal the two public builds, complete action scenarios and oracle for that ticket. Reference must pass the smoke and all controls. The candidate must pass smoke, have a documented target-specific failure and confirm that same failure on a fresh page. Shared failure or unknown error excludes the panel. Preserve the historical rejected panel and lexical negatives as explicit controls.
policies: Use last round's fixed BM25 top three and original visual score. Baseline BM25, reference local RGB pre/post rerank, and identical zero-pixel ranker. Sum zero-based text rank and descending pixel-delta rank (midrank ties), tie-break by BM25. Lock all orders before candidate validation. A fresh page per scenario, smoke first, maximum three candidate scenarios total. Record full scores, orders, real actions, cumulative hits at two/three, input gestures, reference actions and PNG costs. Two fresh browser processes for final qualified tickets.
